reproduction.reason: tmux source-file failed: respawn pane failed: fork failed: Device not configured
reproduction.note: The real failure emitted a JSON diagnostic on stderr, consistent with the existing CLI contract. An unguarded top-level import/dispatch and an empty/unstructured failure result were independently reproduced by fault injection.

cause.launch: A live shell placeholder is killed with respawn-pane -k immediately before forkpty allocates its replacement; this creates the macOS PTY close/open race. An empty tmux pane requires no placeholder process or PTY.
cause.diagnostics: bin/raf.ts had no exception boundary around dynamic import/dispatch; delivery did not validate that nonzero empty or warning-only results contain a structured diagnostic.
cause.limit: The specific XNU out-of-range event was not present in accessible kernel logs; the triggering RAF sequence and ENXIO failure were observed locally.

fix: Create the bootstrap tmux pane with an empty command, then respawn without -k.
Catch CLI import/dispatch exceptions and deliver PRODUCTION_ENTRY_FAILED as JSON on stderr.
Supply a JSON diagnostic for nonzero empty or unstructured results while preserving valid error JSON and TestRunResult output.

red.method: Materialized HEAD versions of bin/raf.ts, src/cli-output.ts, src/agent-adapters.ts in a temporary baseline, with other source files linked unchanged; ran the new test file there.
